title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Ethan Brattli"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + factor(month) + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * residuals(births_model) / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  select(calendar_date, mean_pct_resid)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
#| dpi: 300
holiday_labels <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c("2001-12-25", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-24"))) |>
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ "Christmas Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ "Independence Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ "Christmas Eve"
    ),
    label_date = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ as.Date("2001-12-28"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ as.Date("2001-07-09"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ as.Date("2001-12-20")
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ -32,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ -19,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ -20
    )
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(color = "#2878B5", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = label_date, xend = calendar_date, y = label_y, yend = mean_pct_resid),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#C43C39",
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Birth Residual by Calendar Date",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean residual (% of average births)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
#| dpi: 300
calendar_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_births = mean(births))

ggplot(
  calendar_births,
  aes(
    x = date_of_month,
    y = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.name[12:1]),
    fill = mean_births
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", labels = scales::comma) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Average US Births by Calendar Day",
    x = "Day of month",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Mean births"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
christmas_summary <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / surrounding_average
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_summary, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    title = "Christmas Day Births Relative to Surrounding Days",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Births as percentage of baseline",
    color = "Weekday"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
